items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a morphism of sites restricts to a morphism between the localized sites, fits into the expected commutative diagram of topoi, has its pullback described by the pullback on slices under the identification of the localized categories of sheaves with the slices, and satisfies the identity relating the pullback of the localization functor to the localization of the pullback (statement lines 6481-6509). The proof is a complete argument: continuity and the valuewise identity are treated first (proof lines 6511-6526); the description of the pullback is obtained by computing the lower shriek of the composite and using the two companion identifications (proof lines 6529-6562); exactness and the morphism-of-sites property follow from the equivalence of the slices with the localized sheaves and the criterion for exactness of left adjoints (proof lines 6563-6576); and the final identity is proved by the same computation (proof lines 6579-6596). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two pullbacks through the lower shriek. The claim is H2: a structured computation with each input named.
